statements.venue: Press release introducing the Countering Online Trafficking Act
statements.quote: The technology criminals use may change, but our responsibility to protect the innocent does not.
statements.context: Gallagher introduced a bill to strengthen federal anti-trafficking efforts as criminal groups exploit artificial intelligence and emerging technologies to target children and other vulnerable people.
statements.reason: The only harm discussed is criminals using AI for human trafficking and child exploitation, which is outside catastrophic risk.

record: Introduced the Countering Online Trafficking Act, aimed at human traffickers who exploit artificial intelligence and emerging technologies
grade_reason: His only AI-related material found from 2025-2026 concerns criminals using AI for human trafficking and a general issues-page line on AI leadership for economic strength and national security; neither acknowledges catastrophic risk.
notes: All six web searches ran; none was refused. Search results were dominated by former Rep. Mike Gallagher (R-WI), whose AI material (2023 Five AIs Act, Armed Services hearings) is a different person and was excluded. His official issues page (https://gallagher.house.gov/issues/science-space-and-technology, undated) says American leadership in science and technology 'from artificial intelligence to space exploration' is critical to economic strength and national security; left out of statements because it is undated and only a passing mention. Only page 1 of 4 of his press release list was checked. No source shows him sponsoring or co-sponsoring the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act or signing any other House letter on AI risk. The press release quote was read through a page-summarizing fetch tool that reported it as verbatim; a reviewer may want to confirm the exact wording.
